### 修复细节 / Fix details

- **粘贴附件发送前确认（#45 的附件部分）**：图片、文件及连续粘贴的多附件先进入输入区预览，显示缩略图或文件类型图标、名称和大小；支持逐项移除、取消全部，再由发送按钮或既有发送快捷键确认。
- **防止误发与重复发送**：确认前不创建消息；重复点击不会重复提交，成功项从队列移除、失败项保留。切换会话会清空待发送附件并停止剩余批次；异步剪贴板读取不会把附件带入新会话。发送期间继续输入的文字不会重复携带已发正文。
- **范围说明**：本版只处理 #45 的附件误发诉求，**未新增消息或文件加密**，因此 #45 的加密建议仍未解决。文件选择器、拖拽和应用自带截图工具的既有发送流程保持不变。
- **Confirm pasted attachments (attachment portion of #45):** Images and files appear in a composer preview before sending, with thumbnails or file icons, names, sizes, individual removal and Cancel all. Confirm using Send or the configured send shortcut.
- **Prevent accidental and duplicate sends:** Pasting creates no messages. Repeated clicks submit only once; successful items are removed and unsent items remain. Conversation changes clear pending attachments and stop remaining batch items. Late clipboard reads cannot attach content to another conversation. Newly typed text does not repeat an already submitted message.
- **Scope:** This release addresses only the attachment concern in #45. **Message and file encryption remain unimplemented**, so that part of #45 stays unresolved. Existing file-picker, drag-and-drop and built-in capture send flows are unchanged.

### 验证与未验收范围 / Validation and limitations

- Mac 本地通过 131 个测试文件 / 887 项全量测试、36 项 focused 回归、Electron Node 16.17.1 / ABI 110 数据库自测、双端类型检查、构建、smoke、版本和文档检查。
- 真实 Electron 22.3.27 生产界面与 IPC、隔离资料和回环同事验收通过：混合文字/图片/文件、移除/取消、连续粘贴去重、重复点击、IME/发送快捷键、会话切换、延迟原生剪贴板与浏览器 paste 竞态、多附件滚动、窄窗与深色主题。
- **尚未在 Finder、第三方截图软件，以及 Win7/UOS/麒麟的真实剪贴板格式上人工验收。** Electron 自测使用合成 DataTransfer/File 和测试剪贴板读取 IPC，不访问用户真实剪贴板或聊天资料。CI 构建成功不替代目标系统真机验收。
- Mac validation passed 887 tests across 131 files, 36 focused regression tests, Electron ABI database checks, both typecheck targets, build, smoke, version and documentation checks. Real Electron 22.3.27 UI/IPC acceptance used isolated data and a loopback peer.
- **Finder, third-party screenshot tools, and actual Win7/UOS/Kylin clipboard formats remain unverified.** Electron tests use synthetic DataTransfer/File payloads and test clipboard-read IPC. CI build success does not replace acceptance on target hardware.
